title.narrative: Disaster response to flood victims in 2 rural communities in Pujehun Distric

description.narrative:
Following an emergency meeting held on 5 August 2019, The Office of National Security of Pujehun District and District Stakeholders declared an institutional red alert for the border chiefdom of Sorogbema in Pujehun district due to flooding caused by extremely heavy rains on the 4th to 6th August 2019. This incident surpassed the governments through the various district offices capacity to respond to the emergency with the means and resources planned in the previous year’s National Contingency Plan for the Rainy Season. The Contingency Plan is the local Government standing emergency preparedness and response arrangement and explicitly includes the role and contributions of the Office of National Security (ONS). When the institutional Red Alert was issued, the government requested that ONS assistance is activated and that ONS mobilize necessary support from humanitarian actors and development partners. This Response and Recovery Proposal is in response to that request. According to data collected by the assessment team 97 Household were affected, 9 of the houses totally destroyed, 15 partially damaged. 11 houses were affected by the flash floods. 723 ( Adult men, women and children) in 2 rural communities ( Maleh and Solima) in 1 chiefdom.
Public transport, basic infrastructure such as houses, schools, and health centers, bridges, roads and Telecommunications networks, have been severely damaged. In these conditions, the return of affected communities to normality, as well as restoring basic conditions for trade and transport, will result from mid to long-term recovery process. Approximately 65,000 hectares of crops in Inland Valley Swaps (IVS) were washed away, placing about 97 families at risk of food insecurity. As a result of the of the disaster, 723 ( Adult men, women and children) in 2 rural communities ( Maleh and Solima) in sorogbema chiefdom. Affected families have now lost to essential basic house hold items including food items as life saving support which they have secured for their entire life time. Afected houeshold head have lost hope especially when households are not able to have three squire meal on their own there by preventing them og have a nutritious meal. this inturn exposes them to health risck especialy due to them been exposed to drinking contaminated water. Afeected households have further lost the dignity and reapect they use to enjoy. Families including women and childern are also exposed to harsh weather conditions including cold and mosquito bite.
